# Aliens Eye

> AI-OSINT username scanner: checks whether a username exists across 7,700+ platforms, blending a trained logistic-regression model with a heuristic engine over a 30-dimensional feature vector. Verdicts are tri-state (Found / Maybe / Not Found) with confidence, per-site control checks, cross-site correlation, watch mode, and reproducible frozen-corpus evaluation.

Python >= 3.10, MIT license, installable as `pip install aliens-eye`. The CLI entry point is `aliens_eye`; the stable library surface is the `aliens_eye` package root (`scan`, `correlate`, `load_sites`, `match_profile_url`, `fetch_page`). Detection claims are leads to verify, not proof of identity.
